result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: a loading spinner remains stuck over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, indicating broken or incomplete image loading.

issues.description: A white circular loading spinner with green progress arc is stuck in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar banner image in the Popular right now section, obscuring the food image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image finishes loading and dismisses the loading indicator; add a timeout and error/fallback state so the spinner does not remain over a loaded image.
